audience: finance and sales teams that run their accounting and stock in OfficeGest

useCases.title: Find customers who owe money
useCases.text: List the top debtors and the customer invoices not yet fully paid, then read one customer's balance.

useCases.title: Check a customer record
useCases.text: Search customers by name, tax id or email, then read one customer's contacts, address and type.

useCases.title: Review the sales summary and documents
useCases.text: Read the sales summary for this and last month, then list sale documents of one type and open one for its lines.

useCases.title: Check stock for an article
useCases.text: Search articles by barcode or text, then read the stock quantity of the article in each warehouse.

useCases.title: Find supplier invoices due soon
useCases.text: List supplier invoices not yet fully settled, with the amount pending, and read one supplier's details.

useCases.title: Add a customer record
useCases.text: Create a customer record. The server does not check for duplicates, so search the customers first.
